visitor_id: UUID v4 created by Next.js; optional except customer_linked v1
session_id: UUID v4 created by Next.js; optional
cart_id: UUID v4 used to correlate frontend cart/checkout with Order when known
money: non-negative exact decimal string, up to 4 fraction digits
currency: ISO 4217 uppercase 3-letter code in monetary payloads only
payment_method: stable technical key, not a display/translated label
contact_id: 32 lowercase hexadecimal Shopware Contact UUID; required for contact_received
